description: CLI PoC that builds a simple SELFIES tokenizer vocab, trains a tiny PyTorch regressor, and saves a checkpoint.

outputs.description: PyTorch checkpoint dictionary containing model state and tokenizer vocab
Optional files saved by the PoC; e.g., full state or logs

vocab.mapping: stoi (token -> id) and itos (id -> token) saved in the checkpoint

model_format_notes: Checkpoint is a dict saved with torch.save; reload with torch.load and reconstruct model with matching architecture and vocab.
example_run: python src/selfies_tokenizer_poc.py --train data/hf_dataset_small_train.csv --val data/hf_dataset_small_val.csv --test data/hf_dataset_small_test.csv --target DV_C --out models/poc_selfies/poc_selfies.pth --epochs 5 --batch_size 2
requirements: selfies (optional, script falls back to regex)
